top_signals.title: Euroleague owners seek way forward as NBA prepares to enter Europe
top_signals.summary: On Tuesday, the continent's top clubs turned down an offer from the NBA, raising the prospect of a battle for Europe's teams, players and commercial riches.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New Zealand’s Central Bank Chief Breman Overhauls Top Leadership
top_signals.summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand is recruiting two assistant governors and a chief of staff as Governor Anna Breman overhauls the central bank’s senior ranks almost a year into the job.
